book.name: REVELATION
book.title: Matsh Haschu g Jesus Christ am i Maskogi John Wui

content: Mam has masma ab si has elid g Jiosh an dahm kahchim ch ed

Ab ant hahawa i nen k haꞌichu ep neid. Am ni-tahgio o hab sha mahs mo ab kuhpiꞌokas g dahm kahchim hab sha masma mo ab ge kihjeg. Kuni ep kah g neꞌokij g Jesus. K hab sha kaidag mo g kuikud ch hab kaij ab ni-wui, “Ab g i hihm. Nt am wo m-chehgi mat haschu hemho wa am hab wo e juh iꞌajed imhab.”
T ha hekaj ab si i ni-wehmt g Hekia S-apꞌekam Gewkdag. K shahag wepo mat g dahm kahchim am e chehgi ni-wui. Kuki g geꞌe kownal daikud ab kehk. K an hema daha id ab.

K g wuhioshaj wabsh tonod hab masma mo hegam si s-kehg hohodai mo hab e aꞌaga ‘jasper’ ch ‘carnelian.’ K an kownal daikud wehgaj hab chuꞌig g kiohod. K id s-chehdagi hab masma mo hegai s-kehg hodai mo hab e aꞌaga ‘emerald.’
Kuki an wehgaj hab ep chuꞌig g gokko gamai giꞌik kownal dadaikud. Kuki an ha ab dadha g gokko gamai giꞌik geꞌeged ch s-tohtakaj e enigadadch ch g ohla gigiko ab wahpkch.

Kuki ab geꞌe kownal daikud amjed ab si memhe g wepgi. Kuki ab toahim g tataniki. Kuki g wewaꞌak kuhchki am memeihim baꞌich g geꞌe kownal daikud no pi g Hekia S-apꞌekam Gewkdag wewaꞌak masma e chehgidch am t-wehhejed.
Am baꞌich g geꞌe kownal daikud oki shaꞌi si s-dahpk ch hab masma mo g mi-lihda am tadani ch am wabsh gai tonod. An wehgaj g kownal daikud oki an aꞌai gegok g giꞌik haꞌichu dodakam ch wehsko wuhpui.
K hema hab sha mahs mo g mawid. K hema hab ep mahs mo g wisilo. K hema g wuhioshaj hab mahs mo g oꞌodham wuhiosha. K hema hab mahs mo g baꞌag ch an daꞌa.
K wehsijj idam chuhdp aꞌan. K g ha-aꞌan wehsko wuhpui. K chum hekid neꞌe hab masma:

content.text: “Ab ach si has elid g t-kownalig Jiosh.
Do si hekia s-apꞌekam ch si s-gewkdag ch chum hekid an haꞌichug.”

content: Kuki am neꞌe idam giꞌik haꞌichu dodakam ch ab mahk g has elida ch hoꞌigeꞌelig hegai mo chum hekid an haꞌichug ch an da kownal daikud t an.
K heg wui ab hab waꞌap i shuhullig hegam geꞌeged ch am wuashulig g e-gigiko ch am wecho shuhullig ch ab ihm ch hab chechꞌe:

content.text: “T-kownalig Jiosh, ab ap apꞌedag matt ab wo si m-hehgchulidad ch ab wo si has m-elidad nap pi wehs s-gewkdag ch wehs haꞌichu nahto.
K hab d m-elida mo in hab chuꞌig.”
